implemented_sources: ORDER_TRADE_UPDATE: typed order details, multiple fills, liquidation and ADL classification
MARGIN_CALL: one critical notification preserving all reported positions

deduplication.non_trade: wallet + PERP + symbol + orderId + executionType + status + eventTime + orderTradeTime
deduplication.margin: wallet + PERP + MARGIN_CALL + eventTime + canonical crossWalletBalance and sorted position details

financial_boundaries: Decimal strings only for amounts and prices; integer timestamps and IDs validated separately.
Commission and currency are optional as a pair. Realized PnL is the value reported by this event, not a recomputed account return.

autoclose- prefix, NEW_INSURANCE, CALCULATED or LIQUIDATION identify liquidation; adl_autoclose or NEW_ADL identify ADL. Explicit conflicting ADL/liquidation identities are rejected. ADL identity takes priority over a generic CALCULATED execution.
Risk orders bypass ordinary open-order reconciliation, but still invalidate signed snapshots. One event produces one risk notification, never an additional ordinary order notification.
No whole-position liquidation inference, supplied liquidation price, risk percentage, countdown or delivery-before-liquidation guarantee.

Quantities, original type, execution, status, last/cumulative fills, prices, all three timestamps, IDs, commission, reported PnL and supplied trigger/working/reduce/close flags are retained. Trailing-stop sp is ignored per official documentation.

Public exchangeInfo supplies base/quote/margin units. Missing or failed metadata is labeled unknown and may be retried without private signing. Margin-call cw has no supplied asset identifier and is not assigned an invented unit.
delivery_and_storage: Only the explicitly authorized current-wallet stream can ingest events. Socket generation and captured authorized address are checked before routing.
Background pauses, stream expiry and disconnections can leave gaps; there is no system push or missed-event replay.
Local inbox and read state are scoped by wallet. An already-open detail route hides its previous event immediately on wallet change/logout.

SharedPreferences stores versioned normalized typed event details, not raw WebSocket payloads, keys, tokens, signatures or credentials. Up to 500 recent records and 4 MiB across wallets; oldest records are removed when either limit is reached.

Operations are serialized. Initial load failure/corruption does not overwrite stored data; live events/read changes remain in memory and merge on retry. Persisted read status survives duplicate replay during recovery.

Write failure retains the current in-memory snapshot and a safe retry error. Notifications are best-effort local history, not the durable financial request journal; clearing app data/uninstall removes them. Accepted queued writes may finish after listeners are disposed.
not_implemented: Deposit/withdrawal history baseline, state transitions and notifications
ACCOUNT_UPDATE funding reasons triggering deposit/withdrawal history refresh; balance change alone must not claim on-chain completion
native_verification: Skipped at user request; no device tools, APK installation or real private financial requests.
